description_en: Queries the logs of a cluster that are generated within a time range
description_zh: 查询指定集群某一段时间内的日志列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-common-logs --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --from 1703821542 --to 1703821666 --action-name CreateCluster --operator-uid 137000 --log-request-id 04F0F334-1335-436C-A1D7-6C044FE70000 --action-status Finished --log-type Operation --resource i-abc000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --is-reverse true --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCommonLogs

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range. The time is a timestamp. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time range. The time is a timestamp. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间点。Unix时间戳类型，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the operator
parameters.name: operator_uid

parameters.help_en: The request ID of the action. Logs associated with the specific request ID are returned
parameters.help_zh: 操作的请求ID，作为查询过滤条件
parameters.name: log_request_id

parameters.help_en:
The action status. Logs associated with the specific action status are returned.

Valid values:

*   Finished: The action is completed.
*   Failed: The action failed.
*   InProgress: The action is being performed
parameters.help_zh: 操作状态，作为查询过滤条件
parameters.name: action_status

parameters.help_en: The log type. Logs of the specific type are returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志类型，作为查询过滤条件
parameters.name: log_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource involved in the action. Logs associated with the specific resource are returned. This parameter is not recommended
parameters.help_zh: 操作涉及的资源名，作为查询过滤条件。（不推荐）
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~100

默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display results in reverse order.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否逆序显示。

默认值：true
parameters.name: is_reverse
